resources.name: DFT code with LDA+U+SOI capability (e.g., Quantum ESPRESSO, ABINIT, GPAW)

access.notes: Any publicly available DFT code supporting LDA+U (Dudarev scheme), spin-orbit coupling, noncollinear spins, and PAW pseudopotentials is acceptable.

resources.name: PAW pseudopotentials for Mn, Fe, Co, Ni, O

access.notes: Standard pseudopotential libraries such as SSSP (for Quantum ESPRESSO) or the VASP PAW potentials are acceptable.
